The '''VT-22 light troop transport''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Vokoff-Strood/Legends|Vokoff-Strood]] that was used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The ship possessed a cockpit, four troop deployment bays with four bay doors, and an engine room. It could carry hundreds of people, and ships of this class were used during [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]].
